target: Hilton — 2027 Technology Intern (Software Engineering & Cyber; Connected Room / Mobile)
phase: 4/4 - connected room + bench + report (all must-have v1 complete, measured)
stack: Python 3.12, cryptography 50.0.0 (Ed25519), FastAPI + uvicorn, pydantic, SQLite, pytest + pytest-cov

measurement_methodology.security: single offline LockVerifier (HILTON-DEMO-001, room 101); 500 presentations (100 legit + 400 adversarial across 10 categories, 40 each); full challenge-response each; precision/recall over legit-unlock vs adversarial-deny. tampered_payload + forged_signature both surface deny reason forged_signature (correct crypto outcome).
measurement_methodology.offline_purity: proven two ways: (1) AST import-closure of staykey.lock + credential + antireplay contains no sqlite3/socket/http/httpx/fastapi/etc; (2) verifier decides correctly with sqlite3.connect and socket.socket monkeypatched to raise.
measurement_methodology.latency: in-process (no HTTP socket). offline_verify = finish_unlock x5000 (300 warmup excluded), 2x Ed25519 verify + checks, challenges pre-registered/responses pre-signed outside timing. issuance = credential.issue_credential x2000 (device keygen + Ed25519 sign, excludes DB insert).
measurement_methodology.no_double_book: half-open interval overlap check inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; 32 threads race for 1 room -> 1 winner; 40 overlapping stays for 10 rooms -> 10 assigned, 0 shared.
measurement_methodology.connected_room: ConnectedRoomAuthorizer: static credential checks (sig/property/room/window/revocation) + active-assignment (room's checked-in stay) + device challenge-response; 26 cross-scope attempts (cross-room, impersonation, bad-command, post-checkout) -> 0 leaks.

unmeasured.network_latency: ___ (latency measured in-process via direct calls, not over an HTTP/TCP socket)
unmeasured.real_hardware: ___ (simulated lock; no real BLE/NFC radio, no physical lock)

notes: All Must-have v1 delivered: overlap-safe reservation/assignment (no double-book, incl. concurrency), Ed25519-signed time-boxed Digital Key issuance (short rolling TTL bounded by stay window, refreshable), OFFLINE LockVerifier (property pubkey + synced revocation list only, no DB/network at unlock; proven), challenge-response anti-replay (per-key device key + single-use lock nonce), checkout/room-change revocation, Connected-Room control scoped to active stay (0 cross-scope), FastAPI with {ok,data,error} envelope + validation. KEY DESIGN: credential binds a per-key device public key; unlock proves device possession via challenge-response so a stolen token without the device key is denied (bad_response). Property PRIVATE key stored only in gitignored PEM (0600) / env; guest device private key never reaches the lock; no secret committed. Simulated lock (no BLE/NFC hardware); synthetic seeded data; latency in-process. Out-of-scope (not built): real hardware, guest/lock web UI, BLE session keys, multi-property rotation, audit log, rate limiting.
